title: Animation / Tips and techniques

location.series: IBM Design Language / public web guidelines
location.extent: Complete webpage content-area capture; visible default tab states

slide_intent: Control attention, rhythm and physical behavior so viewers can follow a dense moving message without confusion or fatigue.
strategic_value: Precise forms, consistent movement and readable type can carry IBM’s engineered character through animation.
demonstration: The webpage mixes animation examples and paired accepted/rejected demonstrations across attention, clarity, personality, physicality, sequence/loop structure and typography. The PNG preserves still frames.
practical_value: Plan the focal point and sequence first, then check movement consistency, form integrity, frame rate and reading time against the stated guidance.

content_islands.name: Examples and attention
content_islands.spec: Open with a montage of animation frames, then Focus and Camera examples showing the source’s preferred and rejected treatments.

content_islands.name: Visual clarity
content_islands.spec: Group Complexity, Detail and Consistency with paired geometric demonstrations and captions.

content_islands.name: Personality
content_islands.spec: Follow Precision, Rhythm and Fluidity through diagrams, looping-form frames and comparison panels.

content_islands.name: Physicality
content_islands.spec: Place Mass and momentum and Volume beside their object demonstrations.

content_islands.name: Structure
content_islands.spec: Compare sequential, simple-loop and nested-loop diagrams, including the labelled A–D panels.

content_islands.name: Type
content_islands.spec: End with Presentation and Integrity text specimens, pairing acceptable/rejected examples with reading-direction and distortion guidance.

reference_purposes.Intent: Attention guidance explains reducing confusion and fatigue; complexity guidance relates information density to how much motion a composition can carry.
reference_purposes.Application: The page teaches focal-point transfer, controlled cameras, consistent transitions, staggered rhythm, physical behavior and sequence/loop choices.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The source specifies at least 24 FPS, rejects excessive overlapping action and prohibits stretching, warping or otherwise distorting IBM Plex. Type must remain long enough to read.

ingredient.name: Animated typography
ingredient.role: Preserve reading order and the typeface’s recognizable form.
ingredient.application: Reveal type in an order that supports reading, move it on one axis at a time and leave it visible long enough to understand; maintain glyph geometry.
ingredient.scope: IBM animation guidance. The source describes typical left-to-right, top-to-bottom reading, not a universal rule overriding other writing systems. The PNG alone does not demonstrate timing.
